V-2.title: Verify every published pick against official sources

rules: Only official, first-party sources are cited. Where a value could not be confirmed, it is left blank and labelled unverified - never inferred, estimated or defaulted.
Hotspawn popularity and participation are never used as a probability input.
Research order for a fixture with no line: HLTV first, then prediction markets, then esports books and betting lines, then Valve's official ratings.
An identity join that is not exact, or already reviewed as an alias with an official source, never contributes a probability.
Every original response is archived verbatim so any extraction can be replayed.

ranking_discrepancy.finding: HLTV displays a Valve Regional Standings position dated more recently than the newest global standings file Valve has published in its official repository. For every team compared here the two disagree, and HLTV shows the better position. This project's model rung reads Valve's own file, so it uses the older, lower position. That is the conservative choice and it is stated here rather than silently preferring the newer number.

thunderpick_world_championship_2026.timezone_caveat: Displayed times are rendered in the fetching client's timezone. Only start_utc, taken from HLTV's own data-unix attribute, is timezone-independent. The runner that produced this evidence ran in UTC+2 and a separate read of the same page rendered UTC-4; both resolve to the same absolute instants.

aurora_roster_change.question: Is Aurora's roster change recent, and is it confirmed?
aurora_roster_change.answer: Confirmed from first-party evidence, and NOT recent. HLTV's own transfer log records the rebuild complete on 08/07 (HLTV prints DD/MM), with the individual moves on 29/06, 02/07 and 03/07. Day 3 is 16 October 2026, roughly three months later. Both official rating sources already list the post-change squad.

hltv_transfer_entries.entry: ash named new Aurora head coach
MAJ3R steps down and soulfly benched in Aurora
Official: Aurora complete rebuild with kyxsan

In an interview with HLTV from before the report came out, the Romanian was ominous about the future of the team: "Many things can happen, especially when the big guys are coming with crazy offers. I have n ocomment because if I say something and then the opposite happens, I might get backlash for it."

aurora_roster_change.exclusion_note: HLTV renders the reader comment thread under the article. An earlier read published 15 forum replies as transfer records. Comments are removed before anything is read and the count removed is reported.
aurora_roster_change.consequence_for_the_picks: No probability on this site depends on the roster change, and none should: the change is three months old and both rating sources already reflect it. Any narrative that a fresh roster change explains Day-1 or Day-3 form is not supported by these sources.

irregularities.title: Published inventory does not reconcile with Hotspawn's own fixtures API
irregularities.detail: Hotspawn's API listed 99 CS2 fixtures when read at 2026-10-16T09:44:09Z; the deployed snapshot published 101 rows generated at 2026-10-16T08:18:38Z. Missing from the site: none. Published but no longer listed by Hotspawn: ['1080286', '1081493'], of which 1 had already passed their scheduled start when the API was read (1081493). Hotspawn's fixtures feed is queried with status=scheduled, so a fixture leaves it once it starts; that part is a timing difference between two readings, not a coverage gap. Still unexplained: ['1080286'] - published as upcoming although Hotspawn no longer lists them and their scheduled start had not passed. They may have been postponed or removed; this audit does not assume which. This difference is NOT explained by elapsed time and needs review. No row was added or removed by this audit.

irregularities.title: A published pick cites a URL outside the official allow-list
Picks are published on margins smaller than the spread of their own source
irregularities.detail: The origination ladder publishes a pick for every fixture it can price and has no minimum-edge threshold (the deployed snapshot reports no_edge=0). 3 resolved fixture(s) are decided by less than 5 percentage points: 1079588 Astralis vs MIBR [48.5, 51.5]%; 1079588 Astralis vs MIBR [48.5, 51.5]%; 1079588 Astralis vs MIBR [48.5, 51.5]%. These are arithmetically correct and every one replays from its cited source, but a reader on a phone cannot distinguish a 1.5-point margin from a strong favourite. Reported as a presentation irregularity, not a data error.

irregularities.title: Unresolved fixture 1081502 may be priced under a different team name
irregularities.detail: Procyon vs LOS NINOS (CCT South America 2026 Series #7, 2026-10-16T16:00:00Z): Bovada lists ['Procyon Gaming', 'Los Ninos'] — "Procyon" ~ "Procyon Gaming" (substring); "LOS NINOS" ~ "Los Ninos" (exact), start time agrees; Polymarket lists ['Procyon Gaming', 'Los Niños'] — "Procyon" ~ "Procyon Gaming" (substring); "LOS NINOS" ~ "Los Niños" (token), start time agrees. The names differ, so the identity is NOT verified and no probability is taken from it. Recorded so a reviewer can decide whether a reviewed alias is warranted.

irregularities.title: source_outcomes is published in market order while probabilities is in team order
irregularities.detail: scripts/domain.py::market_analysis aligns `quotes` and `probabilities` to the fixture's team order but records `source_outcomes` in the market's own order. 2 published row(s) therefore carry the two arrays in opposite orders (1081497, 1080289). Every one was verified correct against Polymarket's own archived prices, so no published probability is wrong; but a reviewer comparing the two arrays positionally would invert the favourite. Nothing is rendered from `source_outcomes` on any page today.

unverified_and_limitations: This audit reads only what the archived first-party responses state. Where a source was unreadable the observation is absent, and the absence is reported rather than filled in.
The Valve-rating research model formula is owned by another session and is not reimplemented here; for model rows the official inputs the row cites are verified instead of the arithmetic.
An identity join classified as unverified never contributes a probability. Team names differing between Hotspawn and a book are reported for human review only.
Prices move. Every line carries the timestamp at which it was observed; no line is presented as current beyond that timestamp.
